data.name: Stealgulls
data.detailed_description:
You are a seagull. You are hungry. That tourist has a sandwich.

A chaotic 2-4 player co-op game where you and your mob of seagulls terrorize beachgoers and steal their snacks. Coordinate heists, scream, and balance your endless hunger against the needs of the nest.

Flock Together

Observe NPC routines, coordinate distractions, and execute perfectly timed snatch-and-grabs.

Feed the Nest (And Yourself)

Every morsel you steal can go to the collective goal... or straight into your greedy beak. Your flock is counting on you. But you're so hungry. So very hungry.

MINE. MINE. MINE.

Scream at your friends. Scream at the humans. Poop on sunbathers.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / RTX 2050 / AMD RX 5600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS Monterey (12.0)
  • Processor: Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS Ventura (13.0) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 Pro or M2
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2 GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
